requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-803-1486-4231--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

437-2085-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kelpie Guide is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
437-2085-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
437-2085-4613.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-1465-4247.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-4247.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

533-6441-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
533-6441-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3457-7791-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
3457-7791-7908.description:
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat.

539-3899-4552-4832-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3899-4552-4832-7803.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
969-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

862-4336-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-4336-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

589-1786-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-1786-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4499-4927-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

341-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
341-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Umori.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

64-372-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1379-3259-4460-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-4460-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-4460-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-6595.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

323-997-4681-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

997-3025-5170-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3678-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-3678-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-1329-3200-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1170-1329-3200-4068.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2604-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5631-6753-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5631-6753-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1283-2440-5147-5544.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Skeleton and/or Rogue you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

654-997-5003-6644.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1690-2538-5034-6595.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Lyse Hext.
1690-2538-5034-6595.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Jhoira trigger, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira and Lyse's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Jhoira trigger,, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Resolve the Lyse trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
1690-2538-5034-6595.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1116-3240-5670-6559.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

4381-4929-5224.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2583-3334-5870-5874.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

631-2034-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-2034-6249--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1247-1902-5963.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-1902-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

5147-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5147-5776-5777.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2829-3490-5346.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
2829-3490-5346.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact.
Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to add {R}.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

945-1385-2034-2452-2530.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
945-1385-2034-2452-2530.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {0}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Relentless Dead, adding {C}{C}.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Zulaport Cutthroat.
Resolve the first Relentless Dead trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Relentless Dead trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

811-3525-4474-5169.notablePrerequisites:
Daring Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle and Pemmin's Aura attached to Daring Thief.
An opponent controls at least one creature.
811-3525-4474-5169.description:
Activate Daring Thief by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Daring Thief.
Daring Thief triggers, exchanging control of Khârn the Betrayer and any creature.
Khârn the Betrayer triggers, causing the player who lost control of it to draw two cards.
Repeat.

864-2103-2963.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

1961-3394-4067-4680.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional artifact.
You have at least one card in hand.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
1961-3394-4067-4680.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a creature, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Throne of Geth trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.

1727-3359-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moorland Rescuer, adding one mana of any color.
Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself and Hofri Ghostforge.
Resolve the Hofri Ghostforge trigger, exiling Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer that has "When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to your graveyard".
Resolve the Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Moorland Rescuer token, adding one mana of any color.
The Moorland Rescuer token dies, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the Moorland Rescuer token's trigger granted by Hofri Ghostforge, returning Moorland Rescuer from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the other Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-1209-4486.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to increase only Atla Palani's toughness by at least one.
240-1209-4486.description:
Increase Atla's toughness by at least one.
Activate Mirror Entity an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Mirror Entity ability, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 0/0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
All creatures you control except Atla die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Kozilek died this way, it triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.
